location: From the source repository root, copy these .mjs files into scratch/territory-review-306. Set PROFILE_SOURCE_ROOT to the desired clean source snapshot, or leave it unset for cwd. GIT_EXE may override git on PATH.

prepareEnvironment.PROFILE_SOURCE_ROOT: <clean pinned source root or omit for cwd>

requirements: Install locked project dependencies before running.
Keep heavy browser/build/test processes stopped during timings.
Do not set PROFILE_PILOT for the full four-case matrix.
Leave PROFILE_THRESHOLDS unset for 50 and 100 cases.
The child is spawned automatically with --expose-gc.
PROFILE_COMMON_CONTEXT derives real physical exclusions from adopted public projection and binds them to BOTH variants before public dispatch.
Historical CPU profile and metadata-repair scripts intentionally expect 0041 and its named fixture files.
meaning: Public Core wall-clock profile with clone+validation, not browser FPS/thermals or production-balance evidence.
